posts.description: I don’t think it’s a surprise at this point when I tell you that I love these artworks by Antwerp-based artist Joost Vandebrug . (I mean, tell me they don’t aesthetically rhyme with the KDO logo circles/moons…) Joost Vandebrug explores how separate views and moments come to be seen as a whole.
